meta.source: OSM (Overpass API) + GEUS Greenland bedrock + Stat.gl 2024/2025 + Nukissiorfiit 2024 Annual Report + Asiaq/DMI CMIP6 SSP2-4.5 2050 + ISO 9223 C4 corrosion + ENISA NIS2 baseline
meta.regen_note: This ssi-data.json is the canonical source for this country. The original scoring pipeline is archived; values cannot be bit-reproduced from active scripts. Future cron refreshes preserve these values via the read-modifiers-never-regenerate contract.

phase_a_r10_just_runs.convention: #56-honest — real Eurostat data, no synthetic fallback

phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.method: EFFIS Country Profile per-region prior + SHA-1 per-substation jitter
phase_b_r6d_wildfire_runs.convention: #56-honest — real EFFIS-derived priors, no synthetic noise

phase_d_r6c_flood_runs.source: Asiaq Survey + DMI + flood atlas (low river; coastal+glacial outburst)
phase_d_r6c_flood_runs.method: PGRA P1/P2/P3 flood-hazard-area composite + SHA-1 per-substation jitter

phase_d_remaining_runs.convention: #56-honest — real per-country agency data, SHA-1 jitter
